items.title: Dogecoin ETFs struggled for buyers while rival XRP and Solana funds pulled in $3 billion
items.whyYouShouldCare: The strong inflow into XRP and Solana funds, totaling $3 billion, highlights growing institutional interest and potential liquidity for Solana's ecosystem.

items.title: Solana is about to make transactions 3.3× bigger. That matters more than the number
items.whyYouShouldCare: Increasing transaction capacity by 3.3 times could significantly enhance Solana's scalability, attracting more developers and users to its network.

items.title: Altcoin rally loses steam: Institutional bets fail to save Ethereum, Solana, and Aptos
items.whyYouShouldCare: The slowdown in the altcoin rally, despite institutional interest, indicates potential challenges for Solana's price momentum and overall market confidence.
